A company must implement a new data retention policy to meet regulatory requirements. Sensitive documents in an Amazon S3 bucket must be protected against deletion or modification for a specified period. Which solution meets these requirements?
Activate S3 Object Lock in governance mode for the required objects.
Activate S3 Object Lock in compliance mode for the required objects.
Enable versioning on the S3 bucket. Set a lifecycle policy to delete objects after the specified period.
Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval during the retention period.

A company is developing a serverless application to process orders from an ecommerce website. The application must handle traffic bursts during peak usage and remain highly available. Orders must be processed asynchronously in the order the application receives them. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive orders. Use an AWS Lambda function to process them.
Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue to receive orders. Use an AWS Lambda function to process them.
Use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to receive orders. Use an AWS Batch job to process them.
Use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive orders. Use an AWS Batch job to process them.

A company is deploying a critical application using Amazon RDS for MySQL. The application must be highly available and recover automatically. The company must support interactive users with transactional queries and batch reporting with analytical queries that can tolerate a delay of no more than 4 hours. Analytical queries must not affect transactional query performance. Which solution meets these requirements?

Configure Amazon RDS for MySQL as a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment with one standby instance. Send transactional queries to the primary DB instance and analytical queries to the secondary instance in another Availability Zone.
Configure Amazon RDS for MySQL as a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment with two standby instances. Send transactional queries to the primary DB instance and analytical queries to the reader endpoint.

Configure Amazon RDS for MySQL with multiple read replicas across Availability Zones. Send transactional queries to the primary DB instance and analytical queries to one replica in another Availability Zone.

Configure Amazon RDS for MySQL as the primary database for transactional queries with automated backups enabled. Each night, create a read-only database from the latest snapshot for analytical queries and terminate the previously created database.

A company hosts a public web application on AWS using a three-tier architecture. The frontend web tier runs on Amazon EC2 instances in one Auto Scaling group. The application tier uses a second Auto Scaling group, and the database tier uses Amazon RDS. Both Auto Scaling groups are configured for normal demand. During unexpected demand spikes, long instance startup times delay scaling in the frontend and application tiers. The company must improve scaling performance without affecting the user experience. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
Reduce the number of EC2 instances in both Auto Scaling groups. Increase the desired instance count to meet peak demand.
Set the maximum instance count of both Auto Scaling groups to the number needed for peak demand. Create a warm pool.
Increase the maximum EC2 instance count of both Auto Scaling groups to meet normal demand. Create a warm pool.
Reconfigure both Auto Scaling groups to use scheduled scaling policies. Increase the EC2 and RDS instance sizes.

An insurance company wants to migrate an application that calculates insurance rates to AWS. Calculations must start immediately when customers submit information through the application. A calculation typically takes 10 seconds. A solutions architect must design an AWS architecture for the application. Which solution meets this requirement?
Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to receive the data. Use an AWS Lambda function to process it immediately.
Upload customer data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Launch an Amazon EC2 Spot Instance to process all data uploads.
Set up AWS Transfer Family to receive customer data. Configure an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) job to process the data on a schedule.
Upload data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Invoke an AWS Batch job to process each customer data upload.

A company hosts a website on a group of Amazon EC2 instances. The website stores images and media files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to automate infrastructure creation so that the website can be deployed in multiple AWS Regions. The EC2 instances must use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to store and access data in the S3 bucket. Which solution meets these requirements MOST securely?
Create an AWS CloudFormation template for the web server EC2 instances. Store IAM access keys in the UserData section of the AWS::EC2::Instance resource.
Create a file containing an IAM secret access key and access key ID. Store the file in a new S3 bucket. Create a CloudFormation template with parameters specifying the S3 object's location.

Create an IAM role and access policy that allow the web server EC2 instances to access the S3 bucket. Create a CloudFormation template for the instances that includes an IAM instance profile referencing the role and access policy.

Create a script that retrieves an IAM secret access key and access key ID from IAM and stores them on the web server EC2 instances. Include the script in the UserData section of the AWS::EC2::Instance resource in a CloudFormation template.

An ecommerce company is redesigning a web application to run on AWS. The application needs storage for static website content and must use a Microsoft SQL Server database for customer data. The company must deploy the application resiliently across multiple Availability Zones. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use an Amazon S3 bucket for static content. Deploy an Amazon RDS Custom for SQL Server DB instance.
Use an Amazon S3 bucket for static content. Create an Amazon RDS for SQL Server Multi-AZ deployment.
Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach volume for static content. Deploy an Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance.
Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach volume for static content. Deploy SQL Server on Amazon EC2 instances in two different Availability Zones.

An analytics application runs on multiple Amazon EC2 Linux instances using Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard storage. File sizes and access frequencies vary. Files are rarely accessed after 30 days, although users sometimes request older files to generate reports. The company wants to reduce storage costs for infrequently accessed files and have throughput scale with file system size. It plans to use the TransitionToIA EFS lifecycle policy to move files to Infrequent Access (IA) storage after 30 days. Which solution meets these requirements?
Configure files to transition back to Standard storage when users access them again. Specify Provisioned Throughput mode.
Specify only Provisioned Throughput mode.
Configure files to transition back to Standard storage when users access them again. Specify Bursting Throughput mode.
Specify only Bursting Throughput mode.

A company runs a two-tier web application in an on-premises data center. A single application server runs a stateful application that connects to a PostgreSQL database on another server. The user base is expected to grow significantly, so the company is migrating both tiers to AWS. The solution will use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling, and Elastic Load Balancing. Which solution provides a consistent user experience while allowing both tiers to scale?
Enable Aurora Auto Scaling for Aurora Replicas. Use a Network Load Balancer with the least outstanding requests routing algorithm and sticky sessions enabled.
Enable Aurora Auto Scaling for the Aurora writer. Use an Application Load Balancer with round-robin routing and sticky sessions enabled.
Enable Aurora Auto Scaling for Aurora Replicas. Use an Application Load Balancer with round-robin routing and sticky sessions enabled.
Enable Aurora Auto Scaling for the Aurora writer. Use a Network Load Balancer with the least outstanding requests routing algorithm and sticky sessions enabled.

A company runs an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system on Amazon EC2 instances in one AWS Region. Users connect through a public API hosted on the instances. International users report slow API responses from their data centers. A solutions architect must improve API response times for all international users. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

Create an AWS Direct Connect connection with a public virtual interface (VIF) from each user's data center to the EC2 instances. Create a Direct Connect gateway for the ERP API to route user requests.

Deploy Amazon API Gateway endpoints in multiple Regions. Use Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to direct requests to the nearest endpoint. Configure VPC peering connections between the Regions for the ERP system.
Set up AWS Global Accelerator. Configure listeners for the required ports and endpoint groups for the appropriate Regions. Create an API endpoint in each group.
Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN to establish dedicated VPN tunnels between multiple Regions and user networks. Route traffic to the API through the VPN connections.

A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application also uses an Amazon DynamoDB table and occasionally generates HTTP 500 errors. The table uses on-demand capacity mode, and other applications use it without problems. A solutions architect wants to resolve the HTTP 500 errors without disrupting the web application. Which solution meets these requirements?
Configure DynamoDB to support larger write requests to increase throughput.
Enable DynamoDB Streams to monitor changes to the table.
Configure the application to use exponential backoff and retry queries to the table.
Configure the application to use strongly consistent reads.

A company is migrating a group of Linux-based web servers to AWS. The servers must access shared files through NFS. The company must not change the web server applications. Which solution meets these requirements?
Create an Amazon S3 bucket using S3 Standard for the shared files. Grant the web servers access to the bucket.
Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 bucket as the origin. Store the shared files in the bucket.
Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount it on the web servers.
Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Configure SMB access for the web servers.

A company wants to use AWS Systems Manager to manage a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. Security requirements prohibit all EC2 instances from accessing the internet. A solutions architect must design network connectivity between the EC2 instances and Systems Manager while meeting this requirement. Which solution meets these requirements?
Deploy the EC2 instances in a private subnet with no route to the internet.
Configure an interface VPC endpoint for Systems Manager. Update routing to use the endpoint.
Deploy a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Configure the private subnet with a default route to the NAT gateway.
Deploy an internet gateway. Configure network ACLs to deny traffic to all destinations except Systems Manager.

A solutions architect is designing an architecture with web, application, and database tiers. The web tier must scale automatically. Each tier will use separate subnets, with two public subnets and four private subnets in total. The security team requires that tiers communicate only when there is a business need and that all other network traffic be blocked. How should the solutions architect meet these requirements?
Create an Amazon GuardDuty source/destination rule set to control communication.
Create one security group for all tiers that restricts traffic to the required sources and destinations.
Create a dedicated security group for each tier that restricts traffic to the required sources and destinations.
Create network ACLs for all six subnets to restrict traffic to the sources and destinations required by the application.

A company hosts an application on AWS that has generated approximately 2.5 TB of data over the past 12 years. The data is currently stored on Amazon EBS. The company wants a cost-effective backup solution for long-term storage and must be able to retrieve data within minutes during audits. Which solution meets these requirements?
Create EBS snapshots to back up the data.
Create an Amazon S3 bucket and use the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class to back up the data.
Create an Amazon S3 bucket and use the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class to back up the data.
Create an Amazon EFS file system to back up the data.

A company wants to connect its on-premises network to AWS through AWS Direct Connect. It runs multiple VPCs in a single AWS Region and plans to expand to hundreds of VPCs. A solutions architect needs to simplify and scale the network infrastructure to accommodate future VPCs. Which service or resource meets these requirements?
VPC endpoints
AWS Transit Gateway
Amazon Route 53
AWS Secrets Manager

An ecommerce company runs a multitier application on AWS. The frontend and backend tiers run on Amazon EC2 instances. The database tier runs on an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The backend frequently requests the same datasets from the database, and these repeated calls slow performance. A solutions architect must improve backend performance. Which solution meets this requirement?
Configure an Amazon SNS topic between the EC2 instances and the RDS DB instance.
Configure an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cache. Configure the backend EC2 instances to read from the cache.
Configure an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Configure the backend EC2 instances to read from the cluster.
Configure Amazon Data Firehose to stream calls to the database.

A company operates an Amazon S3 data lake containing large datasets in multiple formats. An application retrieves and processes subsets of data from multiple objects based on filter criteria. For each query, the application currently downloads complete S3 objects and transforms them, which takes considerable time. The company wants the application to query and filter S3 objects directly without downloading them. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use Amazon Athena to query and filter objects in Amazon S3.
Use Amazon EMR to process and filter the objects.
Use Amazon API Gateway to create an API that retrieves filtered results from Amazon S3.
Use Amazon ElastiCache (Valkey) to cache the objects.

A company obtains SSL certificates from a third-party provider and imports them into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) for a public web application. A solutions architect must notify the security team 30 days before the imported certificates expire. The company already has an Amazon SQS queue and an Amazon SNS topic with the security team's email address subscribed. Which solution provides the required notifications?
Create an AWS Lambda function to scan for expiring certificates. Have the function list the certificates in a JSON message and send the message to the SQS queue.
Create an AWS Lambda function to scan for expiring certificates. Have the function list the certificates in a JSON message and send the message to the SNS topic.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for the ACM Certificate Approaching Expiration event type. Set the SQS queue as the rule's target.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for the ACM Certificate Approaching Expiration event type. Set the SNS topic as the rule's target.

A company has an application running on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses hardcoded credentials to access an Amazon RDS database. New regulations require automatically rotating the application service account's database password every 90 days. Which solution meets these requirements?

Create an AWS Lambda function that generates a new random password. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke it every 90 days. Configure the function to upload a JSON file containing the new password to the existing EC2 instances over SSH.

Create a secret in AWS Secrets Manager for the database credentials. Schedule an AWS Lambda function in Secrets Manager to rotate the secret every 90 days. Modify the application to read database credentials from Secrets Manager.
Create an Amazon ECS task that generates a new random password and runs every 90 days. Configure the task to upload a JSON file containing the new password to the existing EC2 instances over SSH.
Create a new EC2 instance that runs a cron job every 90 days to generate a new random password. Configure it to upload a JSON file containing the new password to the existing EC2 instances over SSH.
